description: This file defines the 'distinctAttributeConstraint' class and its methods for managing device attribute constraints in Kubernetes resource allocation.

classes.name: distinctAttributeConstraint
classes.description: A class that manages constraints based on device attributes, ensuring all devices share the same attribute value.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a device to the constraint set if it satisfies the attribute constraints.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a device from the constraint set.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if a request and sub-request match the constraint's request names.

methods.name: matchesAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a device attribute duplicates any existing attribute in the constraint set.
